The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the Titanic.

To understand blockchain technology, imagine a shared notebook that everyone in a large group has a copy of. Instead of one person holding the only notebook, every participant has an identical version. If someone wants to write a new entry, they can't just scribble it in their own book and claim it's true. They have to shout out the new entry to the group. Everyone checks their own notebook to make sure the new entry makes sense and hasn't been written before. If the majority agrees it's valid, everyone updates their copy at the same time. Because everyone has a copy, no single person can secretly erase or change a past entry without everyone else noticing. This makes the record extremely secure and trustworthy, as it is decentralized (no single owner) and immutable (hard to change once recorded).
